@jaelim your jdk is fine. Your problem is that Bazel tries to execute `C:\temp\bazel.US08rqwQ\out\bazel\bin\bash`. Set your BAZEL_SH as described in [Windows installation instructions](http://bazel.io/docs/windows.html) and you should be good to go:

``` bash
export BAZEL_SH=c:/tools/msys64/usr/bin/bash.exe
```
